title: Denuit / Darina
description: DENUIT (Montepellier, France) Fans of Twin Tribes or Boy Harsher? Meet DENUIT, a darkwave/synthpop duo with a gothic techno and industrial edge. With Lis’s hypnotic, siren like voice and Ivi’s unique synths, their live shows captivate audiences across Europe, Mexico, and South America. Mystical yet intense, their sound blends dark atmospheres, pounding kicks, and vibrating basslines for an experience that enchants… and hits hard. DENUIT represents the new generation of electro goth artists shaking clubs and festivals worldwide. Support: DARINA (UA/AT) Half electronic, half heartbeat, Darina’s music lingers long after the sound fades - haunting vocals float over raw synths and grungy textures, blending intimacy with intensity. Blending darkwave and alternative pop, her sound is atmospheric, emotional, and edged with tension. At 19, the Vienna based independent artist carries her Ukrainian roots into every track, infusing her music with the imprint of home, displacement, and memory. After the war uprooted her life, music became her constant - the thread she refused to let go of. In Vienna’s underground scene, Darina is an emerging voice: independent, experimental, and unmistakably her own.

title: Synesthetic Wednesday
description: Synesthetic IVO: Dadaistic raps and invented words which celebrate a modern musical nihilism in an outlandish and humorous manner are Synesthetic Ivo’s trademark. In the debut album „1V0“ and the attached music video „YHLD“ he opens a door to experimental contemporary Hip Hop that stays wide open in his performances. For this release show Ivo is supported by the super group Synesthetic4. Robin Gadermaier, born in Melk, Lower Austria, has been making waves in the Viennese jazz scene for several years. Stylistic range, progressiveness on the instrument, and sonic versatility are central to his artistic process. He takes the freedom to be active in both jazz and pop. For Robin Gadermaier, the stage is one of the last places where one can truly be free. There, his unconventional playing style stands out, as he plays his bass on a stand in the classical acoustic-guitar position. donation with a minimum of 10€ start: 20:30 20:30 Robin Gadermaier solo Robin Gadermaier: bass 21:15 Synesthetic IVO "HALLO" album release Vincent Pongracz: clarinet, vocals Peter Rom: guitar Manu Mayr: bass Andreas Lettner: drums https://www.robingadermaier.com

title: Delta Punk presents: My Son The Doctor (USA), Support: tba
description: Threading the needle between 90s slacker rock and infectious 00s pop-punk, Glamours, the debut LP by Brooklyn fourpiece My Son The Doctor, serves to encapsulate the often riotous, sometimes irreverent, and consistently catchy sound of an act at the forefront of the Five Boroughs’ indie rock scene. The end result of a musical collaboration extending back nearly a decade, the songs on Glamours reflect Brian Hemmert (vox), Joel Kalow (guitar), Matt Nitzberg (bass), and John Mason’s (drums) expeditious—and at times feverish—approach to songwriting and performing. Forged in the crucible of NYC DIY (where they’ve frequently shared the stage with Big Apple peers such as Bodega, Gustaf, and Teenage Halloween), the record’s ten tracks crystalize the outfit’s white-knuckle energy as well as their nimbly reactive take on songcraft, employing both anthemic and raucous qualities in equal measure—discordant, occasionally jagged riffs interweave with memorably off-kilter free association wordplay and tightly wound percussion, creating a space that’s transgressive, spirited, and delightfully weird throughout the album’s 30-minute runtime. Sourced from an improvisational environment and written on a knife’s edge, Glamours emblematizes the project’s fast-and-loose philosophy, built on a foundation of tension and resolve; tender introspection gives way to memorable, maudlin hooks on “Drunk Kids,” meandering subway impressions shift into rowdy call-and-response on “Laurence Bigando,” and breakneck malaise transforms into untuned relief on “Pink Banana.” While steeped in inspiration from alternative heavyweights like Sonic Youth, Hop Along, Jeff Rosenstock, and Weezer, the album embodies the undiluted verve that’s come to define My Son The Doctor alone, a reverberation of sweaty, sold-out shows and the atmosphere one can only find out at the gig. Recorded at Mitch Easter's Fidelitorium in North Carolina, engineered by Jeremy Snyder (IDLES, Pure Adult, Gilla Band), and presented with artwork from Gustaf’s Lydia Gammill, Glamours presents an uncut take on New York-bred indie rock in the 2020s—one that’s never faked, non-algorithmic, and constantly in flux. - Connor Beckett McInerney https://mysonthedoctorband.com/

title: ALBINOBROTHERS
description: Just the short story... ALBINOBROTHERS is Tobias Werner (Ambush,Clear like Blood,Helga Blohm Dynastie) on acoustic guitar and vocals and Ronny Wunderwald (Garda,Helga Blohm Dynastie) on drums. Best description might be "Dark Folk in Cinemascope".

title: Jahn Kemper / Subground Club / Dawn Protection
description: Jahn Kemper Jahn Kemper’s music is characterized by original lyrics that are often melancholic and dark. He is 16 years old, comes from Germany, and has already performed at various live shows across southwestern Germany. In May 2026, the young German-Slovenian musician released his new self-produced album “Spuren” (Traces). He has also appeared as a support act for several bands, including Artemis Rising (Electric Metalcore, Heavy Grounds Aschaffenburg, May 2025), QNTAL (Aschaffenburg Museumsnacht), and The Infamous Her (USA, most recently in March 2026 at Soku in Neustadt an der Weinstraße). Mannheim’s 7er-Radio also reported on the March gig: “Ambitious German-language lyrics with depth, wrapped in powerful metal, came as a surprise. It already takes quite a bit of courage to stand alone on stage and sing. But getting the audience to rock along, performing, and promoting music with a message is on a whole different level.” Subground Club Subground Club are a rock band from Vienna. If you try to find a box to put them in, you’ll fail. The individual tastes of the members, their diverse musical backgrounds, and their different influences combine to create an explosive mix of styles, genres, and sounds that define the original character of their songs. Dawn Protection DAWN PROTECTION is a project formed in 2014 that made a significant impact on the scene with their debut album in the spring of 2015. Recorded at the legendary Studio Fredman—renowned for its work with heavy metal giants—the collaboration resulted in a stunning record that gained widespread acclaim across the global digital landscape. Over the years, the band has maintained an active touring schedule and expanded their discography with several key releases, including their 2022 EP and a recent 2025 single. At its core, DAWN PROTECTION delivers beautiful, emotive music paired with high-level technical proficiency and top-tier production. The sound is primarily defined as Atmospheric Melodic Metal infused with Progressive elements.

title: Delta Punk presents: Dazzling Killmen (Skin Graft/USA)
Lighter on the Moon
description: Lighter on the Moon is a Vienna-based alternative rock band blending space rock atmospheres with punk-driven energy. Drawing from a wide range of influences, the four-piece moves effortlessly between genres, creating dynamic songs that balance raw intensity with expansive, melodic moments. Influences range from The Cure to The Rolling Stones and from Kraftklub to Kraftwerk. Their sound shifts between gritty alternative rock, driving punk rhythms, and spacey textures, making each release feel distinct while staying unmistakably their own. This versatility translates strongly to the stage, where the band delivers high-energy live shows with a tight, confident presence. Lighter on the Moon has released two singles and one EP, and has performed at major events such as Donauinselfest, alongside numerous gigs across Austria. The band is currently working on new material and preparing the next chapter of their sound. Foto: Kathrin Bruckner

title: MACHACEK (AT) presents FEEDBACK FREUD (SWE)
description: Machacek (AT) Gegen das Aufstehen und gegen das Heimgehen - die Wiener Midlife-Punkrocker Machacek knüppeln sich in maximaler Fröhlichkeit durch Proto-Punk und Post-Punk. Und sie fetzen mit dem einzigen Punkrockkunstpfeifer Mitteleuropas einen “primitive loud Rock'n Roll”. Dazu kommt ein bisschen Punk-History: Wer hätte geglaubt, dass der erste Punk-Song 1962 in Peru gespielt wurde? Demolicion - Ein Must-Know und Must-Hear! https://www.youtube.com/@machacek-band Feedback Freud (SWE) With a vibrant breeze from northern Sweden Feedback Freud analyzes your dreams, thrills and hidden desires - and expresses them in a flow of psycho-punk-rock. Ha! Feedback Freud is rooted in psycho-analysis, Vienna, California and Umeå. https://open.spotify.com/intl-de/artist/0MVz1QGdVFsdxJhGpRwWJp Freitag 30.10.2026 im Rhiz, Gürtelbogen 37 & 38, 1080 Wien Doors: 18:30 Start: 19:30 Eintritt: Freie Spende

title: Guacayo
description: GUACAYO verweben sozialkritischen Indie Pop mit warmen Reggae- und Dub-Vibes zu einem Sound, der gleichermaßen unter die Haut und in die Beine geht. Auf der Dancing in the Moonlight Tour zelebriert die Band ihre neue EP Look at the Moon – eine intensive Reise zwischen gesellschaftlicher Reibung, emotionaler Tiefe und dem Wunsch nach echter Verbindung. Getragen von treibenden Off-Beats, exotischen Klangfarben und Sophies ausdrucksstarker Stimme entsteht ein Konzertabend, der zum Tanzen, Loslassen und dazu einlädt, gemeinsam für Frieden und Menschlichkeit einzustehen und das Leben zu feiern. Look at the Moon EP Mit Look at the Moon zeigen GUACAYO einmal mehr, warum ihre Musik weit über klassischen Reggae oder Dub hinausgeht. Die neue EP ist politisch, emotional und unbequem – mal warm und tröstend, mal bissig und aufgeladen. Vor allem aber wirkt sie wie ein ehrliches Statement in einer Zeit, die immer künstlicher, lauter und entfremdeter erscheint. Der Titelsong Look at the Moon , den viele bereits als berührenden Abschluss ihrer Liveshows kennen, erscheint hier erstmals als Studioaufnahme. Zart, hypnotisch und voller Ruhe bildet der Song, der sich wie ein Mantra wiederholt, das emotionale Gegengewicht zur aufgewühlten Energie der restlichen EP. Der Mond wird dabei zum Symbol für Beständigkeit inmitten gesellschaftlichen Chaos’ – ein stiller Begleiter durch die Zyklen des Lebens. Still bleibt die Band ansonsten allerdings nicht. Mit Daddy Issues feuern GUACAYO eine scharfzüngige Abrechnung mit den Mächtigen dieser Welt ab. Die Frage, wie wir erlauben können, dass empathielose Menschen an politische Spitzenpositionen gelangen, wird nicht subtil verpackt, sondern direkt ins Gesicht geschleudert. Wütend, rotzig und absolut zeitgemäß
